name: 80s Film: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the 80s Film look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, 1980s movie still shot on 35mm film, anamorphic lens, practical effects, feathered hair and period wardrobe, visible film grain, neon pink and cyan against deep shadow, backlit haze, lens flares, tungsten interiors, slow dolly and crane moves, smoke drifting through backlight, anamorphic flares sweeping across the lens
negative_prompt: modern clothing, smartphone, digital sharpness, cgi, hdr, clean skin smoothing, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
